# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
Division Wise Structure (with 3 GSTN) of FA Home and Apparel Pvt Limited

# Business Requirement
To handling job order from GGN to Rudrapur and then Rudrapur to any other outsource vendor.

# Scope
?

# Section 2.

# Assumptions
• This change will not impact existing functionalities.

# Section 3.

# Functional Requirements
Need to write about the functional requirement?

# Division-wise Transaction Flow
Note: This Functionality will be work setting wise if user enable the setting “FPPO split Division wise” in Production process order setting.

### 1. Provide option to bind division in Factory Master.
• Currently on opening Factory master the labels name shows site it should be “factory code” & “Factory Name”
• This is an mandatory field(Division) need to add in New & Old UI to bind with factory.
• Division need to be shown for current logged in company.

## 2. Gurgaon Division

### 2.1 Sales Order Received(No Change only for flow)
• Action: Sales OC is received from Buyer.
• Description: The Sales Order Confirmation (OC) is received from the buyer to initiate the process.

### 2.2 Material Requisitions(No Change only for flow)
• Action: Material Requisitions (CostsheetBOMMRLRMPO)
• Description: The material requisition process starts once the sales order is received.

### 2.3 PD and FPO (No Change only for flow)
• Action: PD and FPO creation in Gurgaon.
• Description: After MRL auto Production Order is created. Team will create the FPO and release it to factory in Gurgaon Division. After that, they will attach the PD which will include quilting process.

### 2.4 FPPO (Factory Production Process Order)
• Action: FPPO creation of each process.
• Description: The FPPO of Cutting will be of own factory type where cut pcs will be recorded as output. For the process “Quilting”, the team will raise the FPPO to Other Factory “FA Rudrapur” by selecting execution type as “other factory” .
• From FPPO List(Production > Production Process Order > List) required one option “transfer to other factory” need to provide and after selecting the FPPO user will click on “Transfer to other factory” then a pop will open in which user is able to view bind Division with the factory and user is able to select “site” this hyperlink will be enable only execution type other factory, In case of “own factory” & “outsourced” “Transfer to other factory” hyperlink is disabled.
• This hyperlink allows to click for execution type other factory when GDI is not created for input material for that FPPO.
• When user creating the FPPO manually, Transferred Division need to be auto pick from factory’s Division and in FPPO Creation Division system will pick Division of logged In Division.
• When user click on “Transfer to other factory” then a pop will appear where Division will auto selected by FPPO’s Factory’s Division in freeze mode (From Factory Master) and user have to select the site only.
• Note : In Case of Auto created FPPO, in “FPPO creation Division” field Rudarpur Division need to be shown.
• Note :- Below List(Old & New) will be accessible where FPPO Creation division is matching to logged in Division.
• Review Hyperlink link also required after clicking on it user will redirected on factory production process order list screen (Production > Factory Production Order > FPO List – New > Factory Production Process Order hyperlink > Ordered Qty.).
Once user “Confirm” from the pop-up, system will create new FPPO (Own Factory) automatically in Rudrapur Division and Original FPPO’s(Gurgaon Division) qty will get Zero but in non-cancel mode. System will automatically create Transfer to Site GDI against the Gurgaon Division FPPO. As mentioned in 1.5 Point (Material Dispatch (Transfer to Site)) Screen.
• System will create GDI from input material sites defined in FPPO, it can be single/Multiple.
• The Auto Created FPPO that will create in Rudarpur division, input dispatch site & output received site should be same(To Site selected in Gurgaon division).
• In case user cancel(Parent FPPO) the transferred FPPO then “Auto Created ” GDI, FPPO in Rudarpur Division need to be cancel automatically.
• In case GDN is created/child FPPO split/Revise FPPO, then system will not allow to user cancel the Parent FPPO.
• User is also able to define price for other factory FPPO.

### 2.5 Material Dispatch (Transfer to Site)
• Action: Material has to be Dispatched against this FPPO. Auto-Transfer-to-site GDI will get created from Gurgaon to Rudrapur with reference to the above FPPO.
• Description: The material is dispatched based on the FPPO, and a dispatch note is created, but this Materials dispatched has to be of transfer type rather than against production process order input as against this dispatch we need to show the receiving in Rudrapur division.
• In GDN view process and FPPO no should be visible.

### 2.6 E-way Bill
• Action: Once GDN is created in Section 1.5 Then eway bill will be done.
• Description: The E way bill will be created against the dispatch of the materials from GGN to RDP. This eway bill will be generated against the Goods dispatch note created in section 1.5.
• The transfer to site GDN created in above section will get displayed in GST Doc integration (As Shown in below screenshot with Transfer to site Dispatch Type) where factory name selected in FPPO will show as a party in E-way bill/E-Invoice.

## 3. Rudrapur Division

### 3.1 Transfer from Site (Receiving of Input Items from GGN)
• Action:
• User will be able to do the receiving of Transfer to site created in Gurgaon Division (Section 1.5)
• Upon creation of this transfer, the material received at the site will be auto reserved against this FPO (Section 2.2,2.3)
• Reference of Parent Dispatch from Gurgaon FPPO to be maintained.
• Description: The system will give a provision to the users of Rudrapur division to receive the material against the transfer to site (Section 1.5) created in Gurgaon Division and upon receiving of this, the material will get auto reserved to the FPO created in Rudrapur division.
• QC will not allowed for transferred material.
• No material movement/adjustment will allowed for transferred material in Rudarpur division.

### 3.2 FPPO Creation (By Splitting of Auto Created FPPO of Rudarpur Division)
• In Rudarpur Division for quilting process system will show two FPPO’s one with zero Quantity i.e for Gurgaon division and another with full Qty. for Rudarpur division (which is auto created by Gurgaon division) as mentioned in below screen.
Note: A division column need to add in above screen.
• Action: Required a provision where user can split whole/Partial to create the outsource FPPO of quilting process if required.
• Description: The system will give user a provision to create a child FPPO in Rudrapur based on the parent auto created FPPO raised by the Gurgaon division.
• The qty for which the child FPPO can create by Rudrapur Division through split, that qty will get reduced from the parent auto created FPPO in Gurgaon Division.
Step 1: - RDP team is creating a Outsource FPPO by Splitting the Parent auto created FPPO.
• Qty from GGN to RDP: - 6000
• RDP Creates 3000 Units order to Outsource (Screens Below).
• Balance Qty left in Parent FPPO: - 3000
After doing that, the Parent auto created FPPO which was created from GGN to RDP will get reduced by 3000 Units and we will see a new Row in the FPPO screen showing the order created in RDP division.
Note: User will be able to see Only those FPPOs of the division and Factory in FPPO list for which he has the permission.

### 3.3 Material Dispatch
• Action:
• The input material will be dispatched to the outsource Job worker against this FPPO.
• Reference of Parent-FPPO and Parent-Dispatch will be maintained.
• Description: The material for outsourcing is dispatched to the job worker with a Child-Dispatch-Note, and references to the parent FPPO and dispatch are maintained. The dispatch type here will be as usual “Production Process Order Output”
• Available site stock will not have hyperlink to allocate the material (In case auto created FPPO & Splitted FPPO.)
• The user is able to revise the auto-generated FPPO up to the quantity that was originally created.
• For example – OC is created of 120 PCS and FPPO is auto-created for 100 units. when user update or modify the FPPO, qty will be update originally created quantity of 100 units. they can revise the quantity, but not exceed the initial 100 units.
• Case 1
• Company A have OC of 120
• User trasnffered FPPO for 100 qty in Rudarpur Company(Company B).
• Then user is able to do modification(Creating order in Rudarpur or outsourcing the order) in Rudarpur company upto 100 Qty.
Note: - Additional (Adhoc) material can also be dispatched against the above FPPO.
Once the materials are dispatched to Outsource vendors in FA RDP. Against that GDN, the Eway bill and E Invoice can be created.
Once the GDN is created then that will be moved to GST Doc Integration for Eway bill.
Eway Bill: -

### 3.4 Output Material Receipt
• Action: Output material to be received against the FPPO between Rudrapur division and outsource vendor.
• Description: Output materials are received from the outsourced vendor and the consumption details are recorded against the FPPO.

### 3.5 Supplier Invoice (At RP for outsource Job Work)
• Action: Creation of Supplier invoice against the Child FPPO (Job Work) for Outsource vendor at FA RP.
• Description: Once the semi-finished materials are received in RP then the supplier invoice will be created against the Child FPPO created in section 2.2

### 3.6 Additional Process in RDP Other Than Quilting (Discussion On Hold till New UI)
• Action:
• Handling of Additional Process in RDP other than Quilting.
• The additional Processes Created in RDP will have ref of Parent FPPO Created in GGN division.
• Description: The GGN division will give the Order of Quilting to RDP Division. But RDP division can do some additional Process also against that Order. So, this will be handled via GRN Receiving New > List > update re-process hyperlink as mentioned in below screen where the Source of the Stock (Parent FPPO / FPPO Created in RDP for quilting Process) is maintained.
• Once User click on update “Add Process” hyperlink then below mentioned screen will open, where user will Add–Process before/After the Quilting process (Stock should be available at that moment).
User will create a FPPO as per above screen & Add extra input items in Article tab as attached in below screen confirm the transaction system will create a FPPO of added process type in FPO List as mentioned in below screen.
As soon as user confirm and release the production system will create a GDI along with picklist of output semi-finished material which need to sent to Supplier/Factory as mentioned in below screen.
User will create GDN as manually as mentioned in below screen.
If FPPO (Alteration) is for outsource supplier then GDN should reflect in E-invoice/Eway bill integration bill where user will generate e-way bill of that GDN/Challan.

#### Supplier Invoice (FPPO Alteration)
If FPPO alteration is for outsource supplier then its GRN should reflect in GRN pending invoice and Supplier invoice.

### 3.7 Material Transfer
• Action: This output material will be dispatched to Gurgaon via Transfer to Site.
• Description: The output material is dispatched from Rudrapur to Gurgaon, with Transfer to site transaction by maintaining the parent FPPO.
• In FPPO list there will be option Transfer output material, User is able to allow transfer output material only for those FPPO for which “Transfer to other factory” field is “ No” and it should be Auto created FPPO or it’s Split FPPO, otherwise it will show a message “Transfer Output Material is applicable for only Auto created or it’s Split FPPO ”.
• New UI Look for Buttons functionality need to be follow same as.
• When user click on transfer output material then system will raise automatic transfer to site GDI with picklist QTY. of output material as mentioned in below screen. User is able to create multiple GDI’s as per the Stock availability and GDN will create manually.

### 3.8 Misc. Invoice (Job Work Invoice to FA GGN by FA RDP)
• Action: Job work Invoice will be performed by Misc. Sales Invoice.
• Description: Once the Materials is dispatched to FA GGN by FA RP. FA RP will create a Misc. Invoice to FA GGN via invoice type FPPO – other Factory then followed by E invoice and E way bill.

#### Misc. Invoice: -
• Note: While doing the misc. sales from Gurgaon to RDP, already tagged price in the FPPO, will be applied in this kind of sales and purchase.

#### E Invoice: -

#### E Way Bill: -

## 4. Gurgaon Division (Continued)

### 4.1 Material Receipt
• Action: Output material to be received against this Main-FPPO by receiving against the transfer to site created from Rudrapur (section 2.6).
• Description: The output material from Rudrapur is received against the Main-FPPO, by receiving against the transfer to site dispatch created in (section 2.6) with consumption details recorded against the Parent-Dispatch-Note and Parent-FPPO, along with the receiving details of the Child-Dispatch-Note from Rudrapur.
• While doing the receiving in GGN against transfer from site then original FPPO number need to shown which was 0
• As soon as misc. sales invoice created in rudarpur division system will show data in Pending supplier invoice tab below screen mentioned.
Validation need to be handle.
• Change in PD/BOM for consumption increase, in this case Rudrapur have to revise and update their FPPO with latest PD and if that material have to come from Gurgaon then Adhoc material have to transfer manually against Original FPPO(From Gurgaon Division through “Adhoc Transfer against Production Process order” which will create Transfer to site GDI and GDN will create manually and in Rudrapur Division GIN/GRN manually).
• Transferred FPPO no will not show in Common GDI.
• Only same divisions wise FPPO should visible in Common GDI FPPO (Program Permission).
• Cancellation of FPPO will allowed for logged in division FPPO.
• Put a validation in both Division that for further process where output is different, then user cannot create FPPO GDI until the original FPPO output is received Gurgaon Division. For Example there are four process Cutting, Stitching, Finishing and Packing. Stitching is being done by Rudrapur division as a jobwork then till the output Stitch Pcs are received to Gurgaon Division, user cannot make GDI for Finishing Process. We can discuss this during specs discussion.

# Note: - Transfer to Site and Transfer from site should have misc. sales & Purchase and ITC-04 Handling

## 5. Report to See additional Processes against the Parent FPPO
• A Report will be given where FA GGN can see the additional Process done at FA RDP against the parent FPPO shared by FA GGN with rate details.

## 6. User permission need to handle for FPPO Tools
User permission need to provide for all FPPO tools instead of “Log Print”, “Ok”, “Send to smart factory”, “Dispatch Instruction”, “Vendor to vendor transfer”. This need to be implement for “New” & “Revision”.
• By default for all tools setting will be enable.

## 7. WIP

#### Division Level (Where WIP will be shown at division Level)

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 8 rows · columns: Case 1 (text), Column 2 (text), Column 3 (text)]
| Case 1 | Column 2 | Column 3 |
| Job Order Created Material Dispatched to RDP via TRF to Site | Gurugram FPPO | Total Gurugram Site Qty + Total Transfer to site Qty |
| Child Job Order Created Material dispatched against this FPPO Output not yet received | Rudrapur Division | Production process order input |
| Case 2 |  |  |
| Job Order Created Material Dispatched to RDP via TRF to Site | Gurugram FPPO | Total Gurugram Site Qty + Total Transfer to site Qty |
| Child Job Order Created Material dispatched against this FPPO Output received | Rudrapur Division | Production process order input – Consumption in Rudrapur |
| Case 3 |  |  |
| Job Order Created Material Dispatched to RDP via TRF to Site Output received | Gurugram FPPO | Total Gurugram Site Qty + Total Transfer to site Qty – Consumed Qty |
| Child Job Order Created Material dispatched against this FPPO Output received | Rudrapur Division | Production process order input – Consumption in Rudrapur |

#### Company Level (Not to show double WIP and to show WIP actual at Company Level instead of division Level)

[TABLE 2: Table 2 · 8 rows · columns: Case 1 (text), Column 2 (text), Column 3 (text)]
| Case 1 | Column 2 | Column 3 |
| Job Order Created Material Dispatched to RDP via TRF to Site | Gurgaon Division | Production process order input issued to Outsource vendor from FA Rudrapur |
| Child Job Order Created Material dispatched against this FPPO Output not yet received | Rudrapur Division | Production process order input issued to Outsource vendor from FA Rudrapur |
| Case 2 |  |  |
| Job Order Created Material Dispatched to RDP via TRF to Site | Gurugram FPPO | Production process order input issued to Outsource vendor from FA Rudrapur – Consumption in Rudrapur |
| Child Job Order Created Material dispatched against this FPPO Output received | Rudrapur Division | Production process order input issued to Outsource vendor from FA Rudrapur – Consumption in Rudrapur |
| Case 3 |  |  |
| Job Order Created Material Dispatched to RDP via TRF to Site (1000) | Gurugram FPPO | 500 will be shown pending to RDP and 500 to Outsource vendor |
| Child Job Order Created Material dispatched against this FPPO (500) | Rudrapur Division | 500 will be shown pending to RDP and 500 to Outsource vendor |

##### Job Order Creation Flow
• After click on create job order system will open the below given pop-up where user can made and review the process wise FPPO.
• In the old functionality, On the click of Factory Production Process order div “>>” system redirect to the applicable process screen against each process user has provision to create the new FPPO against open qty.
As per new UI this pop will be replace with below.
• In-case user clicks on “Ordered (Qty.)” field then below attached po-up will open.
• In-case user clicks on “Received (Qty.)” field then below attached po-up will open.
• For the reallocation we are not opening any pop-up screen. Since we didn’t find any use of this, so we are considering the reallocation from this hyperlink
• To Create New job order in New screen user will click on “Action” Button then user will open Below mentioned screen in which user will fill the required detail.
• Currently it is opening below mentioned screen after clicking on new order column hyperlink.

##### How to do amendment in existing Job Order
If user want to edit any FPPO then user has to come over the below attached screen where we have given the option to click on edit button, based in this system will drag it on the FPPO list where user can edit the FPPO as per his requirement.
Once user client on the any FPPO then system will open the FPPO will open in view mode. We have given some features over there.
• All: If user want to show the all status of FPPO then user will prefer to go in All section.
• Pending Action: If any FPPO is waiting for action like RTF & RFP then user will prefer this section.
• Waiting: If any FPPO is on waiting state then they will prefer this.
• Closed & Completed: Closed and completed status FFPO should come here.
• Cancelled & Rejected: Cancelled and Rejected status will be come this section.
• In the header of screen, we have given the option to Release for Prod. where user can change the status of any Job order with single and multiple selection.
• New Job Order: This is an option that user can add the alteration feature from here.

##### Job Order View Page Screen
• This is view mode screen of any FPPO where user can check and verify the details of FPPO and if user wants to do the changes then user will click on the Revise Order.
• After click on revise order system will open the Job order screen in editable mode.
• Also given a feature to Expand and collapse all feature where user can expand and collapse in on go for all section.
• User can also take a print of all section through print tool button. In the print button we need to print the same FPPO print which we using in currently FPPO click. We also need a provision in layout engine mapping where user can add the user print from their by default the system print will open if user bind and print over layout mapping engine then the priority will work on user print.
• If user want to close this view then there is one option in header i.e. “close order”.
• Arrow works like a back key.
Note: We need the floating filter on the Job order list.

### Create New Job order or Add additional article detail
Here we also giving an option to add output & input article. If user wants to add the additional article detail, then we provide the provision where user can user the add output item & add input item details.
This option should come when user will come through the FPPO list on the clicking of New Job Order tool.
In this we need to filter the data of default site and if user need to see the others site data then they can filter out it from the grid.
Note : we need an option of filter the all pop-up fields for both section
In this we have given the provision to add the additional process detail over here, So here we can add the output & input item here through the button: Add Output” Item & “Add Input Item”
By default, the add to input toggle should be enable mode because if user will add any output item in the grid then the same will be reflect on input section as well. If user want to add additionally input item like thread etc.. in the input item, then they can add it from the add input item button.
Note :-
For Output Item: - When we will add any output against the FPPO for those input & output semi-finished will visible but user can select either input or output semi-finished and system will auto picked that item in the input section as well with 1 is to 1 consumption. As per our discussion with tech, we don’t need the Add to input toggler right now we’ll look this in future scope.
For Input Item: - System will check the stock from FPPO input & output site for free stock, System should check the stock from the FPO linked sites and also check the user permission. System should show the stock of OC reserve material, Adhoc indent stock, closed indent and cancel indent stock.

• Create Debit Note : To make the DN against any Job order.
